name: @comchatx/cx-amazon-finance-playbook
description: Ties out your Amazon payouts and finds what each product earned.
author: ComChatX

comchatx.name: Amazon Finance Playbook
comchatx.about: 对上亚马逊的每笔回款，算清每个产品赚了多少。

about.en: Where your Amazon money is now: deferred, held in reserve, available or paid out, and when each sale's money reaches your bank.
about.zh: 你在亚马逊的钱现在在哪：递延、预留、可用还是已付出，每笔销售的钱什么时候到你的银行。

about.en: Every fee and charge Amazon takes: what it is, how it is worked out, when it posts and on which line.
about.zh: 亚马逊收的每一种费用：是什么、怎么算、什么时候扣、记在哪一行。

about.en: Refunds, claims, reimbursements and adjustments, what each does to your money, and the order or shipment each ties back to.
about.zh: 退款、索赔、赔偿和调整对你的钱有什么影响，各自对应哪个订单或货件。

about.en: What each product earned after all of Amazon's fees and your own costs, and what each way of counting changes.
about.zh: 每个产品扣掉亚马逊所有费用和你自己的成本后赚了多少，以及不同算法会改变什么。

about.en: Matching a settlement or a month to what reached your bank and to your books, and where each difference comes from.
about.zh: 把一期结算或一个月和银行到账、账本对上，说清每一笔差额从哪来。

about.en: Which tax a money line carries, who owes it or has paid it, and where each tax document is.
about.zh: 一行钱里带的是哪种税，谁欠、谁已代缴，每份税务文件在哪。

about.en: Which SP-API read or report holds each money fact, with the role it needs, how far back it goes and how late it arrives.
about.zh: 每项财务数据在 SP-API 的哪个接口或报告里，需要什么角色，能往回查多久，延迟多少。

money-where.zh: 我在亚马逊的钱现在在哪：可用多少、递延多少、预留多少，下一笔回款什么时候到账。

fees-review.zh: 上个月亚马逊扣了哪些费用，各是怎么算的，和之前比有什么变化。

product-earnings.zh: 上个月每个产品在亚马逊赚了多少：扣掉亚马逊所有费用和我自己的成本。

settlement-check.zh: 把最近一期结算和到账金额对上，说清楚每一笔差在哪。

refunds-review.zh: 上个月的退款、赔偿和调整各是多少，对应哪些订单或货件。
